approvalDetails: Review the action and its exact arguments

localDateHelp: Dates use the organization time zone. Ambiguous daylight-saving times require an explicit offset.

subject: Verified identity subject

invalid_transition: This call action is not available in the current state.
provider_error: The provider could not complete this action.
bookingHint: Ask to book an appointment in chat. The assistant checks availability, asks for your name, and waits for confirmation before booking.
unsupported_audio: This provider does not support the supplied audio format.
attachmentLimit: Files must be no larger than 2 MB.
enableLiveMessaging: Authorize live sends (also requires the server enable flag)
emailDraftRequired: Hold AI email responses for approval
providerSetupNotice: Mock connections send no real messages. Live adapters require tenant credentials, explicit enablement and separate end-to-end verification.
template_required: An approved message template and consent are required.
unsupported_attachment: This attachment format is not supported.
saasMockNotice: SaaS foundation: payment and verification demonstrations are mocked. No real charge is made. Live providers and production operation require separate verification.
planChangePolicy: Upgrades require a confirmed checkout for a full new period. Downgrades apply at renewal. No automatic proration, tax or real payment is performed.
tokenUsageNotice: Mock LLM token usage is unreported. Displayed totals cover recorded usage only; mock events do not create real charges.
supportScopeNotice: Platform access requires a separate allowlist. Customer conversations require a tenant-approved, expiring support grant and audited access.
upgrade_required: Your plan limit was reached. Upgrade or reduce usage to continue.
verification_required: Verify the administrator email to continue.
subscription_required: Activate or renew your subscription to continue.
usage_warning: Your usage is approaching the plan limit.
payment_failed: Payment failed. Review your subscription and grace period.
reservationNotice: Uncertain deliveries keep allowance reserved until a verified provider status resolves the send.
invalid_model_output: The model returned an invalid response. No booking was confirmed.
invalid_model_checksum: The configured model files failed verification.
invalid_model_manifest: The configured model manifest is invalid.
model_license_required: The model license review is incomplete.
inference_hardware_required: A compatible inference host must be configured.
context_limit: The conversation exceeds the model context limit.
booking_confirmation_unclear: I could not clearly understand your confirmation. Please confirm the proposed details or say cancel.
demoLoginNotice: Sign in to the local SmileCare demo.
isolatedStudioNotice: Text tests use a disposable database and mock providers. They do not book real appointments, send messages or verify voice quality.
useCaseHelp: The template records your intended use. Instructions and tools define behavior; the current regression suite covers booking.
unsavedChanges: Unsaved changes. Save or discard before leaving this page.
bothLocalesRequired: Both Bulgarian and English remain supported. Interface, conversation and voice preferences are independent.
providerPreserved: Existing voice and model settings are preserved. A mock test does not validate live speech.
permissionIntersection: Tools must be permitted by both the assistant and execution agent. Agent changes invalidate earlier test evidence.
twoAgentHelp: The receptionist handles communication and delegates authorized tasks to the execution agent. Shared agent settings stay in Advanced.
external_activation_blocked: External channels cannot be activated from this wizard. Configure and verify each integration separately.
voice_acceptance_blocked: Live voice acceptance is blocked: listening, consent recognition and Bulgarian dated speech still require verification.
required_tests_missing: Run and pass booking, rejection and ambiguity tests in both languages for this saved configuration.
agent_config_changed: Agent configuration changed. Save the draft and retest.
mock_test_not_live_proof: Mock tests cannot authorize activating a live model. Use the existing administrator configuration path.
saveBeforeTesting: Save a draft before running tests.
setupNeedsAssistant: Create a tenant with its initial assistant before starting setup.
testBeforePublish: Run the required Bulgarian and English regression scenarios before activation.
audio_test_unavailable: Audio simulation is not implemented here. No acoustic pass is claimed.
sharedBusinessWarning: Activation changes tenant-wide business hours, timezone and mock calendar service. This affects every assistant in this tenant. Pending approvals and active calls block activation.
confirmConfigurationAction: I confirm the selected configuration action and its tenant-wide effects.
countsNotSuccessRates: Counts include all stored records, not success rates. Live voice readiness is a separate gate.
directEditingWarning: Saving here changes the active configuration directly. Use a draft to test changes first.
transcriptPrivacy: This diagnostic view shows message metadata only. No retained transcript, patient details or private model reasoning is copied into it.
noPersistedBooking: No appointment is persisted for this conversation. A proposal alone is not a booking.
traceMemoryNotice: Voice traces are bounded process-memory diagnostics. Restart or retention can remove them. Monotonic times are not wall-clock timestamps.
syntheticReplayNotice: Choose a saved draft and scenario in Test Studio. This does not copy or replay the private conversation.
business_config_changed: Business configuration changed. Save and retest.
outbound_tool_blocked: Outbound messaging tools cannot be enabled through this activation.
runtimeEvidenceNotice: Provider configuration, mock outcomes and live acceptance are separate. See recorded evidence before activating a channel.
operationMetricsScope: Measurements since this backend process started. Counts are samples, errors are failed operations, latency is the arithmetic mean. Median/p95/p99 and a historical time window are not available.
providerStatusScope: Status reflects configured capability, not connectivity, speech quality or external delivery. Live verification requires separate recorded evidence.
connectionUnavailable: Connection unavailable. Check the local service and try again. An interrupted write may have completed; check its result before repeating.
assistant_disabled: Assistant is disabled. Enable the intended configuration and retest before activation.
faqKnowledgeScope: These are the saved bilingual exact-match FAQ entries, not an indexed document knowledge base.
versionScope: Only versions activated through the setup workflow are recorded here. Legacy edits are not reconstructed; automatic rollback is not supported.
template_receptionist: Welcome customers in Bulgarian or English, clarify their booking request, and delegate authorized booking actions to the execution agent. Request explicit confirmation before booking. Escalate when requested.
template_support: Assist customers in Bulgarian or English using the configured FAQ. Clarify requests, delegate only permitted tools, and offer human handoff when needed. Confirm any booking before creating it.
template_general: Provide concise help in Bulgarian or English. Explain available actions, delegate permitted tasks to the execution agent, request confirmation for booking, and respect human takeover.
test_worker_busy: Another isolated test is running. Refresh results, or retry when it finishes. Your draft was not changed.
draftConflictHelp: The saved revision or activation conditions changed. Refresh results. If another editor saved the draft, reload the latest copy; unsaved edits remain until you choose to discard them.
reloadSavedDraft: Reload saved draft and discard local edits
active_calls_block_activation: An active call blocks changes to the shared business calendar. Wait for it to end.
pending_approvals_block_activation: Pending approvals block shared calendar changes. Resolve them first.
diagnosticSnapshotNotice: Recorded snapshot. Refresh to inspect newly recorded events; missing stages are not reconstructed.
widgetScopeNotice: Website text chat uses a demo calendar and simulated model. Telephone and browser voice are not certified. Publishing a snippet is not installation verification.
widgetOriginsHelp: One exact HTTPS origin per line, including any nonstandard port. No wildcard, path or credentials. Local HTTP is restricted to the configured demo example.
widgetFaqApproval: I approve the saved FAQs for public visitors.
widgetSaveRevokes: Saving settings unpublishes this widget and invalidates existing sessions. Republish after verification.
widgetNonceHelp: Create a challenge, place its exact text at the shown site path, then verify. This proves file control, not customer identity.
widgetDomainVerified: Website file control verified. Browser installation remains unverified.
widgetInstallHelp: Place this single script in the HTML or CMS custom-code area. Allow the widget origin in script, frame, style and connection CSP policies.
widgetInstallUnverified: Installation is not verified by generating a script. Test iframe loading, BG/EN chat and mobile/keyboard behavior on the real site.
widgetPublishHelp: Select the already-tested and activated assistant draft for this integration. All origins must be verified; only the restricted visitor tool set is exposed.
widgetActionConfirmation: I confirm the selected publish, unpublish, rollback or permanent revoke action. Existing visitor sessions will be invalidated.
widgetPublished: Widget version published. Installation and production acceptance remain separate.
template_sales: Explain approved services in Bulgarian or English, answer configured FAQs and delegate only permitted tasks. Ask for explicit consent before booking. Do not invent prices, availability or sales outcomes.
faqApprovalHelp: Enter approved business content in both languages. Exact-match FAQ responses are supported; this is not an indexed knowledge platform.
widgetGreetingBg: Здравейте! Как мога да Ви помогна?
widgetPrivacyBg: Демо чат. Текстът се пази според политиката на бизнеса. Не изпращайте чувствителни данни. Часовете са отделни бизнес записи.
widgetPrivacyEn: Demo chat. Text is retained under the business policy. Do not send sensitive data. Appointments are separate business records.
googleSetupNotice: Owner action required: configure a web OAuth client and authorize Calendar and Gmail separately. Keep live operations off until explicit approval.
googleClientSecret: Client secret (never stored in this browser)
conciergeManagementOrigin: Approved widget origin for management links
conciergeMeetAuthorization: I authorize Google Meet creation when supported
conciergeLiveAuthorization: I explicitly authorize this application to create/update/cancel events and send workflow emails for this tenant.
queueControlNotice: Queue status does not pause or resume the assistant. Use the conversation controls for takeover.
internalNotePrivacy: Staff only. Do not enter passwords, verification codes or unnecessary personal information. Notes follow conversation retention.
googleOwnerLoginNotice: Sign in with the Google account approved by the owner. Other accounts cannot access this staging workspace.
p16ScopeNotice: Configuration and local test evidence do not certify live voice, payments or external channels.
p16BoundedNotice: This view is bounded. Older records may be omitted; do not use it as a complete audit.
p16Step_test: Pass required Bulgarian and English tests
p16InstallationUnverified: Domain proof and widget publication are configuration evidence. Actual installation and live outcomes still require independent checks.
p16MockReady: Ready for the tested mock Web Chat scope.
p16NoDraft: No editable draft. Start guided setup or review your published assistant.
p16NoCurrentProof: No current editable draft with release evidence.
p16QualityNotice: Suggestions use structured failure records or categorical operator reports. Recorded ambiguous voice decisions are included when available. No transcript analysis or autonomous AI tuning occurs. Accepting a suggestion changes no live configuration; run and review BG/EN tests in Test Studio.
p16NoSignals: No failure signals in this bounded view. This is not proof of perfect quality.
p16AnalyticsNotice: Aggregated operational records include synthetic records. Optional funnel events require owner enablement and explicit visitor consent; counts are not conversion, revenue or attendance.
p16UnmeasuredFunnel: Widget impressions, qualification, reminder receipt and attendance have no verified measurements.
p16LeadPrivacy: Only request metadata is shown. Open the originating conversation under its normal permissions to review context.
p16UsageHistory: Measured usage by day and provider
p16CostsNotice: Usage quantities are not currency charges. Compute cost estimates and reconciled provider charges are unavailable; customer invoices are shown in Billing.
p16NoUsage: No reported ledger events for this period. Missing instrumentation is not zero consumption.
p16DimensionsUnavailable: New instrumented events include assistant/channel allocation; historical unallocated events remain explicit. Generated TTS duration is not proof that speech was heard. Provider-certified SIP/PSTN charges are unavailable; forecasts cover reported quantities only.
test_evidence_expired: Test evidence is older than seven days. Rerun the required suite before publishing.
p16AnalyticsOwnerNotice: Disabled by default. Publishing this setting shows an unchecked visitor choice. Only consented, content-free workflow evidence is retained for at most seven days; withdrawal and chat clearing remove it.
p16FunnelNotice: Only opted-in sessions are represented. Stages count once per conversation and consent interval. Mock receipts and connected-provider receipts stay separate. These counts do not establish site-wide conversion or revenue.
p16NoConsentedEvents: No retained consented events. This is not zero visitor activity.
p16AdjustmentNotice: Sandbox accounting only. No provider refund is sent. Original invoices and usage remain unchanged; append-only adjustments are capped at the paid amount.
p16AmountMinor: Amount in minor currency units (EUR: cents)
p16ConfirmMockAdjustment: I confirm this simulated accounting adjustment.
p16MockAdjustmentSaved: Mock adjustment recorded. No real refund was sent.
p16ForecastNotice: Linear estimate using the observed average since month start, with at least one elapsed day. Reported events only; missing instrumentation is excluded. This is not a currency cost, invoice or capacity guarantee.
p16AdoptionNotice: Derived from existing server records. Missing timestamps remain unreported. Publication is not proof of installation; cohort completion and drop-off are not yet measured.
p16Unsaved: You have unsaved widget changes. Save or discard them before leaving or publishing.
language_coverage_missing: Bulgarian and English coverage are both required.
p16ReportQualityNotice: Select only an issue you reviewed. No transcript or contact is copied. This creates a reviewable suggestion, not a prompt or permission change.
p16Source_OPERATOR_REPORTED: Operator-reported observation; not an automatic diagnosis.
p16Source_RECORDED_METADATA: Recorded structured metadata; content was not analyzed.
p16SloNotice: Configurable targets, not observed service levels or a customer SLA. Existing job counts are a bounded snapshot. The temporary staging VM stops on its approved deadline.
p16NoErrorBudget: Error budget is not evaluated: the required uptime/error observation window and p95 telemetry are unavailable.
p21PriceHelp: Informational price only. No payment is collected.
p21IntervalHelp: Choose dates and times in your business timezone:
p21InvalidLocalTime: Choose a valid, unambiguous time for this timezone.
p21ScheduleScope: These closed dates and periods apply to the mock calendar. Connected Google Calendar uses its separately approved settings.
setupValidationHelp: Check the highlighted fields before saving or continuing.
preview_no_slot: No valid synthetic slot was found within the 14-day preview window. Check working hours and closures.
previewStale: Earlier configuration; save and rerun tests
setupTested: Saved draft tested with mock providers; not activated
